summary: All 19 confirmed findings are fixed in code. For every code fix but two, a unit test or a browser step was seen failing in this session with the fix switched off (the guard run, or the browser check against a build without the fixes); the two exceptions are the loader half of corrupt-pad-settings-kill-loop and the text change of keys-named-directly-in-pad-texts, whose tests pass but were not seen failing. One thing found on the way is not fixed and is high: the controller's focus mark cannot be seen on any button (ui.css clips it), so a pad pilot sees the focus on fields, sliders, selects and list rows only; that file is not mine (first open issue). This was the second session of this role: the first one ended at 16:35 without a report, with most fixes and their unit tests already in commits 27613a0, 39000a5 and ea92fac, and with red tests for three fixes it had not written yet. Done in this session: those three fixes in Input.ts (aim cap, click and wheel in pad mode, pad loop survives a throwing frame), sticks kept silent after a menu, lever-two-pads-same-dev, two further paths of menu-button-can-be-given-away (the menu button as chord modifier, the menu moved onto a modifier), German words in the pad help lines, the new steps of scripts/pad-check.mjs (47 checks in a run before, 114 now), docs/CLIENT.md section Controls, and tools/dev/guards/pad-core.json (9 switches before, three of them no longer matching; 41 now, all caught). Final results: tsc clean for the three packages; vitest 779 passed and 2 expected failures in 46 files (764 passed, 4 failed, 2 expected failures at the start of this session); build ok; guards 41 caught of 41; pad-check 114 of 114 checks; e2e ok. The pad-check against a build with 14 of the fixes switched off failed 24 checks, the ones written for those fixes. Ports 8420 and 8421 belonged to a dev server that is not mine at every probe (PID 69296, started 17:59 from an interactive shell), so pad-check and e2e could not run as written; both were run with the scripts' own PRIMACY2_DEV_PORT=8440 and a data folder of their own. Nothing is committed: the last checkpoint commit is still ea92fac from 16:35, the background loop did not commit during this session.

openIssues: HIGH, not one of the 19, not fixed, not in my files: the controller's focus mark cannot be seen on any button. Measured on the screenshots of a full pad-check run: 0 amber pixels around the marked Launch button, the marked Resume button and the marked 'Station services' button, against 669 in the screenshot with a marked quantity field and 1284 in the one with a marked row of the galaxy list. Measured on a page with the built stylesheet: a marked button as styled 1 to 2 amber pixels, the same button with clip-path none 441 to 496, a marked tab 0, a list row 489 to 556, an input 824 to 952, a select 534, a slider 740. Cause: packages/client/src/styles/ui.css line 35 gives every '#ui button' a clip-path for its cut corners (since 2026-11-12), and line 297 draws the mark as an outline with an offset and a glow, both outside the box, so both are cut off; '#ui .list button' has clip-path none and shows it. It has been so since the mark was added on 2026-11-14 09:08; neither reviewer nor the verifier looked at pixels. A pad pilot cannot see which of Launch, the tabs, Resume, Assign or Undock is in focus. Fix for the owner of ui.css, one line: lift the clip on a marked button ('[data-device="pad"] #ui button.padfocus { clip-path: none; }') or draw the mark inside the box (an inset box-shadow or a negative outline-offset). A browser step that counts amber pixels around a marked button would then keep it; I did not add one that fails today. docs/CLIENT.md names the gap.
